build_jit_function_def: build a JIT AST tree view from a Python function definition for TorchScript compilation
build_jit_class_def: build a JIT class definition AST from a Python class with methods, properties, and class-level assignments
build_python_statement: build a TorchScript tree view statement from an AST node such as if, for, while, or with
build_python_expression: build a TorchScript tree view expression from an AST node such as binary ops, calls, or subscripts
get_class_properties: get a list of Property objects representing the properties of a Python class for JIT compilation
